question: In the electromagnetic spectrum, the frequency ranges of X-rays and $\gamma$-rays can overlap. In such cases, what is the primary basis used to distinguish an X-ray from a $\gamma$-ray?

options.A: Their speeds in vacuum are different.
options.B: Their source of origin (electronic processes vs nuclear processes).
options.D: Their direction of propagation in space.
